outer_split.note: Phase 2A grouped split (leakage groups = dyads_v1 connected components); inner fit/val also grouped

preprocessing.name: federated-safe label-free v1
preprocessing.numeric: aggregated (count,sum,sumsq) -> global mean impute + z-score; sd=1 if var=0
preprocessing.categorical: aggregated label-free counts -> training vocabulary one-hot; MISSING column iff missing seen in training; unseen/other missing -> all-zero UNK
preprocessing.fit_rows: inner-fit rows only (validation and test never contribute)
preprocessing.fit_via: sufficient statistics of the 21 natural clients (identical to pooled computation; partition-invariant)

iid.method: deal whole leakage groups by largest remaining positive/negative row quota

seeds.note: no 3-seed convention existed in Phase 2A (only seed 42); spec default adopted

model_fixed.grande: GRANDE 1.0.0 GRANDE_Module (db79c860): dropout 0, data_subset_fraction 1, bootstrap false, missing_values false, no embeddings, no compile; Adam betas (0.9,0.95), lr split_values 0.01, split_index_array 0.01, estimator_weights 0.005, leaf_classes_array 0.01
model_fixed.mlp: Linear(D,128)-ReLU-Linear(128,64)-ReLU-Linear(64,2); Adam lr 1e-3 default betas; PyTorch default init after torch.manual_seed(seed)

training.selection: pooled validation ROC-AUC (centralized/FedAvg); local-only: client validation ROC-AUC, or weighted validation loss if the client's validation has one class; if a client has no validation rows: train for the median best epoch of the other clients
training.fedavg: full participation; weights = client training-row counts; trainable params only; fresh local Adam per round; clients with < 2 training rows get weight 0 for that fold (recorded)

threshold: per run: maximize macro-F1 on that run's validation predictions over grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.01, ties -> closest to 0.5; applied to the same run's test predictions

metrics.global: pooled out-of-fold test predictions over the 5 folds per (method, partition, seed); ROC-AUC primary; macro-F1@0.5; macro-F1@val-threshold; accuracy; confusion matrix
metrics.seed_aggregation: mean +- SD over the 3 seeds (repeated training on the same folds; no p-values)
metrics.per_client: per natural wave from pooled OOF predictions per seed

quantization.what: client updates delta = theta_local - theta_global, per trainable tensor
quantization.scheme: symmetric per-tensor INT8: s=max|delta|/127, q=clip(round_half_even(delta/s),-127,127) int8; zero tensor -> s=0,q=0
quantization.no: error feedback, stochastic rounding, sparsification, entropy coding
